title: 第7章 升龙指晚上很可怕第8章 我押苏凡笑面虎
slug: 邪鼎第3739章本祖是她的师尊
content_zh:
“确定？”
许三阴再次询问。
阴冷的眼神，如一条盯着猎物的毒蛇。
一瞬间，苏凡明显感觉到一股无形的压迫感笼罩而来，空气仿佛凝固，几欲窒息。
苏凡点头。
脸不红心不跳，丝毫不慌。
这时候，不但要镇定，还得保持沉默，别问东问西，问多了反而容易招人猜疑。
“奇怪。”
“怎么就突然失去踪影？”
终于。
许三阴收回目光，狐疑地嘀咕一句，转身离去。
许三阴一走，压迫感也随之消散，苏凡赶紧合上石门，虚脱地靠着门后，大口大口喘着气。
“瞧你这点出息。”
大黑狗睁开眼，眼神里满是鄙夷。
“我要有你这么强的实力，我也不怕。”苏凡不服气的回瞪过去。
这死狗，典型的站着说话不腰疼。
不过话说回来。
大黑狗好像从来没谈过自己的实力？
“你到底什么修为？”
苏凡好奇。

“本皇的修为？”
大黑狗微微一愣，傲然笑道：“苦修一万年，你也赶不上。”
“吹吧你。”
苏凡直翻白眼，低头看着手里的竹简。
灵诀？
“灵诀，说直白点就是一种提升战斗力的手段。”
“不过灵决，也有品级之分，最差的是下乘灵决，许三阴给你的灵决，多半就是下乘。”
大黑狗一把抢过竹简，查看片刻，满脸嫌弃。
“果然是下乘灵诀，想当年这玩意，本皇都懒得多看一眼。”
大黑狗瞧不起，是因为它见多识广，神通广大，但苏凡不一样。
他就是一个刚踏入修炼一道的小菜鸟，下乘灵诀在他眼里就是宝贝。
“狗哥，你是知道的，我悟性差，让我自己领悟，也不知道要多久才能悟出灵诀的奥妙，所以，你帮帮我呗！”
苏凡蹲在地上，轻轻地给大黑狗捶背。
大黑狗露出一脸享受，老神在在的说道：“帮你也不是不行，但本皇有个条件。”
苏凡愣了下，谄笑道：“咱们哥儿俩，谈条件是不是有点见外？”
“还是见外点好。”
“本皇的条件，其实对你来说很简单，今后提炼的气血珠，咱们一人一半。”
这条件，确实简单。
可现在，苏凡刚踏入修炼一道，很需要气血珠。
于是。

苏凡眨着眼，硬生生挤出两滴眼泪，委屈巴巴的说道：“狗哥，我拿你当兄弟，你却惦记着我的气血珠，太让人伤心。”
“别装可怜，本皇不吃这一套。”
大黑狗目露鄙夷。
没看出来，小小年纪就有当影帝的料。
“行。”
content_en:
"Are you sure?"
Xu Sanyin asked again.
His cold eyes were like a poisonous snake staring at its prey.
For a moment, Su Fan clearly felt an invisible sense of oppression coming over him. The air seemed to be solid, almost suffocating.
Su Fan nodded.
His face didn't turn red, his heart didn't beat, and he didn't panic at all.
At this time, not only should you stay calm, but you should also remain silent. Don't ask questions. Asking too many questions will lead to suspicion.
"Strange."
"Why did you suddenly disappear?"
Finally.
Xu Sanyin looked away, muttered suspiciously, turned and left.
As soon as Xu Sanyin left, the sense of oppression dissipated. Su Fan quickly closed the stone door and leaned against the door in exhaustion, breathing heavily.
"Look at your potential."
The big black dog opened his eyes, his eyes full of contempt.
"If I were as strong as you, I wouldn't be afraid." Su Fan stared back unconvinced.
This damn dog typically stands and talks without pain in his back.
But then again.
The big black dog seems to have never talked about his own strength?
"What kind of cultivation level do you have?"
Su Fan was curious.
"What is my emperor's cultivation level?"
The big black dog was stunned for a moment, then smiled proudly and said, "You can't catch up even if you practice hard for ten thousand years."
"Blow you."
Su Fan rolled his eyes and looked down at the bamboo slips in his hand.
Spiritual secret?
"Ling Jue, to put it bluntly, is a means of improving combat effectiveness."
"However, spiritual arts also have grades. The worst ones are inferior spiritual arts. Most of the spiritual arts Xu Sanyin gives you will be inferior."
The big black dog snatched the bamboo slip and examined it for a moment, his face full of disgust.
"Sure enough, it's the Infernal Spirit Art. I think back then, I didn't even bother to take a second look at this thing."
The big black dog looked down upon him because he was well-informed and had great powers, but Su Fan was different.
He is just a newbie who has just entered the realm of cultivation, and the inferior spiritual art is a treasure in his eyes.
"Brother Dog, you know that my understanding is poor, and I don't know how long it will take me to figure it out on my own, so please help me!"
Su Fan squatted on the ground and gently beat the big black dog's back.
The big black dog showed a look of enjoyment, and the old god said calmly: "It's not impossible to help you, but I have a condition."
Su Fan was stunned for a moment, then said with a flattering smile: "We brothers, aren't we being a bit unreasonable when negotiating terms?"
"It's better to stay out of sight."
"My emperor's condition is actually very simple for you. From now on, each of us will have half of the Qi and Blood Beads refined."
This condition is indeed simple.
But now, Su Fan has just stepped into the cultivation path and is in great need of Qi and Blood Beads.
then.
Su Fan blinked, squeezed out two tears, and said aggrievedly: "Brother Dog, I regard you as my brother, but you still care about my Qi and Blood Beads. It's so sad."
"Don't pretend to be pitiful, I don't accept this."
The big black dog looked contemptuous.
I didn't realize it, but he already had the makings of a movie star at a young age.
"OK."
